original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳交通部长呼吁提升港口效率与竞争力以促进区域贸易
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳交通部长Joseph Bukari Nikpe呼吁提升港口效率、推进数字化并加强交通互联互通，以将加纳打造为西非领先的贸易与物流门户。他表示，实现这一目标需要加纳港务局、政府、私营运营商、监管机构及交通物流价值链各方持续协作。该消息目前仅来自单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳交通部长呼吁提升港口效率、数字化水平和交通互联互通
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Joseph Bukari Nikpe, the Minister for Transport, has called for improved port efficiency, digitalisation and stronger transport connectivity to position Ghana as a leading trade and logistics gateway for West Africa.

key_facts.fact: 部长称实现该目标需港务局、政府、私营运营商和监管机构等持续协作
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mr Nikpe said achieving the ambition required sustained collaboration among the Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority (GPHA), the government, private-sector operators, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders across the transport and logistics value chain.

uncertainties: 目前仅有一个来源（MyJoyOnline）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
